preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two lines: the shuffled string and the remembered substring.
Both the shuffled string and the remembered substring are non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.splitlines()[0]) and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: Both the shuffled string and the remembered substring consist only of digits.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == min([candidate for candidate in generate_candidates(stdin.splitlines()[0], stdin.splitlines()[1]) if is_valid_candidate(candidate, stdin.splitlines()[0], stdin.splitlines()[1])])
postconditions.description: The output is the smallest valid integer n that can be formed by inserting the length of n (as a string) into the shuffled string such that the remembered substring appears in n.
